mxhaptics.config.title: MX Haptics
mxhaptics.config.test.keybindHint: ⚡ Test: assign a key to 'Test haptic vibration' under Options > Controls > Key Binds > MX Haptics.
mxhaptics.config.test.intro: Otherwise, toggle a 'Test vibration' below and click 'Save Changes' to fire the vibration.
mxhaptics.config.test.quickButton.toolti: Fires a fixed test vibration (pattern 1, intensity 75) when you click Save Changes. The toggle is not persisted.
mxhaptics.config.test.eventButton.toolti: Fires this event's currently edited pattern/intensity when you click Save Changes. The toggle is not persisted.
mxhaptics.config.bridgeUrl.tooltip: WebSocket endpoint of the local Logi Options+ haptic plugin (default: HapticWeb).
mxhaptics.config.trustAllCertificates.to: Only enable this if your local plugin uses a self-signed certificate.
mxhaptics.config.pattern.tooltip: Index of the haptic waveform sent to the plugin. See the HapticWeb playground for what each pattern feels like.
mxhaptics.config.intensity.tooltip: 0-100. Sent as an optional second byte; plugins that don't support it ignore it.
mxhaptics.config.cooldownMs.tooltip: Minimum time between two triggers of this event, to avoid continuous vibration.
mxhaptics.command.test.notconnected: Haptic bridge not connected. Is Logi Options+ running with HapticWeb installed?
